about_the_game:
Tiny Monster Haven is an idle creature collector that sits on the side of your screen allowing you to go about your day while having cute monster companions roaming around.

The demo takes place in the starting area and allows you to battle and collect 10 different monsters. The full game will allow you to expand the size of your Haven multiple times and features additional minigames, more decorations and over 3 times as many monsters to collect and evolve! 

Choose your Starter:
Take on your role as monster caretaker by hatching your first monster companion.

Grow crops:

Plant various types of crops and watch them grow while you play with your monsters. Once they're ready you can harvest and feed them to your monsters to improve their stats!

Cook delicious meals:

Spoil your monsters by cooking them a variety of tasty snacks and meals! These delightful treats will further boost and level-up your monster's skills, making them more effective in combat. Each meal will boost different stats.

Battle wild monsters:

Wild monsters will occasionally show up to challenge your monsters to a duel. Engage them in tactical turn-based combat and defeat them to earn coins, experience and to have a chance at getting new monster eggs!
You can do the battles manually or enable an auto-battle option.

Race day:

Enter your monsters into the race minigame to see if they can out-perform their wild opponents!  

Decorate your Tiny Monster Haven:

Liven up your cozy Haven by purchasing beautiful decorations such as flowers, rocks, bushes and trees.

Enjoy Seasons, dynamic weather, day/night cycle:

Experience the passing of the 4 seasons with your monsters. Each season has its own weather patterns such as rain or snow. Be on the lookout for certain wild monsters that only appear at specific seasons or at certain times of the day!

Tweak your experience:

Easily change the size and position of your Haven and choose if it should stick to the right or left side of the screen. You can also set the game to use a different monitor.
There are also plenty of music and audio settings: tweak music volume, enable/disable weather sfx and mute or enable battle music.
